title: Etale devissage reduction of bounded-support flattening
statement: Fix $d\in\mathbf N$. Suppose that for every $n<d$, every affine base $T$, every affine smooth morphism $g:Y\to T$ of relative dimension $n$ with geometrically integral fibres (integral after every residue-field extension), every finite-type quasi-coherent module $N$ on $Y$, and every quasi-compact open $V\subseteq T$ such that $N|_{Y_V}$ is finitely presented and flat over $V$, there is a $V$-admissible blowup making the canonical module strict transform of $N$ flat. Let $S$ be qcqs, $f:X\to S$ quasi-compact and locally of finite presentation, $F$ a finite-type quasi-coherent module, and $U\subseteq S$ a quasi-compact open such that $F|_{X_U}$ is finitely presented and flat over $U$. For $s\in S$ let $F_s$ be its tensor pullback to the scheme fibre $X_s$. Suppose $\dim\{x\in X_s:(F_s)_x\ne0\}<d$ for every $s$, with empty support assigned dimension $-\infty$. Then there is a $U$-admissible blowup making the strict transform of $F$ flat over the new base. Schemes, module properties, flatness, dimension, smooth morphisms, pullback, admissible blowups and their canonical strict transforms use the conventions of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], [def-nagata-admissible-blowup], [def-trf-module-strict-transform], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], [lem-pqf-finite-type-ideal-module], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Module tensor pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback]; integrality is [def-pc-integral-scheme].

proof.text: At a point of nonzero fibre support, devissage transfer supplies an affine smooth geometrically integral family of relative dimension n equal to the local support dimension. Local dimension is at most global dimension, so n < d. Apply the assumed smooth-family assertion to its finite pushforward module and use the transfer equivalence to flatten the pulled-back original module.

At a point outside the fibre support, the residue-field support criterion shows its original stalk vanishes. The finite-type support is closed, so restrict to a zero-module neighbourhood. Identity base change and the unit-ideal blowup solve this local problem. Compactness of X selects finitely many of these and the devissage neighbourhoods.

The affine etale bases are quasi-compact over the quasi-separated S. Adjoin empty-source diagrams over a finite affine base cover, so both sources and bases are jointly covered. Apply finite etale flattening descent. At d=0 the support is everywhere empty, and the second and third steps alone apply.

theorem exists_flat_moduleStrictTransform_of_smooth_affine
    (d : ℕ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ n : ℕ, n < d →
      ∀ (S X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S]
      (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f]
      [GeometricallyIntegral f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
      (U : S.Opens), IsCompact (U : Set S) →
      (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).IsFinitePresentation →
      (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).IsFlatOver (f ∣_ U) →
      ∃ B : IsAdmissible S U,
      (@moduleStrictTransform _ _ f B.I
        (B.I.isFiniteType_toModules_sheaf B.finiteType) F inferInstance).IsFlatOver
          (pullback.snd f B.I.blowupMap))
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set S))
    (hfp : (F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hflat : ∀ x : X, f x ∈ U → Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f x))
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F)))
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim {x : f.fiber s |
      ¬ Subsingleton (((tensorPullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F).presheaf.stalk x)} <
        (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ B : IsAdmissible S U,
      (@moduleStrictTransform _ _ f B.I
        (B.I.isFiniteType_toModules_sheaf B.finiteType) F inferInstance).IsFlatOver
          (pullback.snd f B.I.blowupMap)
